title: Year in Review
logline: Michael premieres his homemade 'Year in Review' video at the Christmas party as a gift for Holly, and the car wash footage shows Dwight and Angela kissing behind the dumpster, which ends with Andy and Dwight dueling in the parking lot.
outline: A: Michael makes a Year in Review video for Holly and premieres it at the Christmas party; it exposes Dwight and Angela, and Michael has to live with ruining Christmas. B: The secret explodes: Andy confronts Angela, learns Phyllis knew, and duels Dwight in the parking lot; Angela walks away from both. C: Erin's first office Christmas: she made everyone an ornament, and hers for Andy is the one that helps. Order: cold, A, B, C, A, B, A, B, A, B, C, tag
theme: The truth comes out at Christmas whether you're ready or not
storySoFar: Michael's homemade 'Year in Review' video for Holly premiered at Phyllis's Christmas-in-Hawaii party and showed Dwight and Angela kissing behind the dumpster at the car wash. Andy learned Phyllis knew since October, challenged Dwight to a slap duel in the parking lot (Andy slapped his car, Dwight slipped on ice), and Angela left them both for her cats; Andy and Dwight called a truce. The wedding is off. Erin gave Andy an ornament of four singing Andys. Michael called Holly for the first time in a month; she laughed, comforted him and said she misses him. Jim's proposal is next Friday at five in the parking lot (sparklers spelling PAM, with Andy and Kevin helping); he made Michael promise to be 'extremely nowhere'. Darryl starts in sales in January.

scenes.recap: Creed gives Meredith her Secret Santa gift early, and it's a mink coat with someone else's name sewn in.

beats.text: CHRISTMAS PARTY DAY
Secret Santa. It's a mink coat. Don't read the name inside.
It says 'Property of Bonnie.'
Bonnie's in a better place. Florida.
Fits great.

scenes.recap: Michael shows Jim and Pam the Year in Review video he made for Holly; he'll premiere it at the party and mail it to Nashua.

beats.text: Feast your eyes. 'Scranton: A Year in Review.' Forty-one minutes. Directed by me.
Forty-one minutes?
It's for Holly. Everything she's missing. I'll premiere it at the party, then mail it to... the N-place.
Did you watch all the footage first?
Jim, I lived it. I don't need to watch it.

scenes.recap: Phyllis tells Angela that after today they're even; Angela doesn't trust it.

beats.text: Angela, after today's party, I'll give you back the gavel. We'll be even.
Even. And you'll forget what you saw.
I've already forgotten. Mostly. Bob says I have a mind like a steel trap.
What did she see? I'll pay. I have forty dollars and a gift card.

lines: Six more months and I'll be married to a lovely man with a carriage.
Nothing will happen at this party. I've checked every detail. Twice.

scenes.recap: Erin hands out handmade ornaments, one for everyone, and saves Andy's for later.

beats.caption: hands Kevin a tiny ornament shaped like a chili pot

beats.text: I made everyone an ornament. I never had an office Christmas. Or, like, a lot of Christmases.
It's a chili pot. Erin. It's my whole life.
Do I get one?
Yours isn't ready. It's very detailed. You'll get it at the end.

lines: Andy's ornament is a little choir of four Andys singing.
I made it, and then I felt weird about it because he's engaged. So it's in my drawer.

scenes.recap: The party starts; Michael announces the premiere of his video at three o'clock sharp.

beats.text: THE CHRISTMAS PARTY
Welcome to Christmas in Hawaii! There's pineapple. There's a ukulele. Bob paid for both.
And at three o'clock: the world premiere of my film. There will be tears. Bring tissues.
How long is the film?
Forty-one minutes. Forty-three with the credits.
One thousand and four days.

beats.caption: eats pineapple straight off the platter

scenes.recap: Dwight secretly gives Angela a cat carved out of a beet; she's moved, and they almost get caught again.

beats.caption: hands her a small cat carved out of a beet

beats.text: It's Garbage. Your cat. Carved from my finest beet.
Dwight. It's... it's beautiful. It's staining my hand.
That's how you know it's real.
Hey, the movie's starting! Babe, why is your hand purple?
Beet salad. Phyllis's recipe. Let's go.

scenes.recap: Michael's film plays; at the car wash segment, Dwight and Angela are kissing behind the dumpster in the background.

beats.text: And here's Toby leaving. Good riddance. I mean, good luck.
And now: the car wash. Look at Holly. Look at that hose work.
Who's behind the dumpster?
That's... huh. Is that Dwight? Kissing... Pause it. Who has the remote? Angela?
Okay. That's the end of the film. Forty-one minutes was a lie. It was six.

scenes.recap: Andy asks Angela if it's true, learns Phyllis knew since October, and challenges Dwight to a duel.

beats.text: Angela. Was that... inventory?
Andrew. It was one time. Several times. It was a few dozen times.
Did anyone else know?
Since October, honey. I'm sorry.
So that's what it was. I feel terrible. Also, finally.
Dwight Schrute. Parking lot. Now. I challenge you to a duel.
I accept. Choose your weapon.
Hands. Open hands. I have a very good slap.

scenes.recap: Michael calls Holly to confess he ruined Christmas and a wedding with a home movie; she comforts him.

beats.caption: calls Nashua for the first time in a month

beats.text: Holly. It's me. I made you a movie and it ruined a wedding.
No, I didn't know. I didn't watch it. I lived it.
You're laughing. Are you laughing? Okay. It's a little funny. Oh, it's so funny.

lines: She said the truth was going to come out anyway, and that I'm a terrible editor.
She also said she misses me. I didn't charge her a dollar.

scenes.recap: Andy and Dwight duel with open-handed slaps in the parking lot, badly; Angela leaves them both.

beats.caption: hums a war chant in a low bass

beats.text: Your humming does not frighten me, Bernard.

beats.caption: slaps Dwight, misses, and slaps his own car
dodges, slips on ice, and goes down

beats.text: Best Christmas party we've ever had.
Stop it. Both of you. I don't want either of you. I want my cats.

beats.caption: two men lie on the cold asphalt

beats.text: Truce?
Truce.

scenes.recap: Andy, cold and defeated, stops at reception; Erin gives him his ornament after all.

beats.text: Andy. Are you okay? You're wet. And sad. Wet-sad.
I lost a fiancée and a slap fight in the same hour. It's a personal record.

beats.caption: hands him a tiny ornament of four Andys singing

beats.text: It's a quartet. Of you. So you never have to sing alone.
Erin. That's the nicest thing anyone's ever made me.

lines: Worst Christmas of my life. I have a tiny choir of me, though.
I'm going to put it on my rearview mirror. They can sing me home.

scenes.recap: Jim asks Michael to promise not to film, plan or throw anything next Friday at five.

beats.text: Michael. Next Friday, five o'clock. Promise me no parties. No movies. No anything.
Why? What's next Friday at five?
Nothing. Absolutely nothing.
I promise. I will be extremely nowhere.
